---
title: "Reoadmap"
---

The items listed here are all planned features. Generally anything listed here
is guaranteed to make it into a future versions. Priority is mostly based
on what I feel the need to add. If you see a feature you'd like to be added
sooner let me know on [GitHub](https://github.com/julius383/PageSieve/discussions).


- [ ] Add advanced element selector mode
    - [ ] Type casting for extracted data.
    - [ ] Add simple filters
    - [ ] HTML tree viewer
- [ ] Improver error reporting on failed selectors.
- [ ] Improve JSON display component (ResultsViewer + SavedLibrary)
- [ ] Add apify actors as alternate client for ScrapeConfig.
- [ ] Improved status tracking and logging.
- [ ] Add settings page to extension.
- [ ] Improved error recovery when network fails.
- [ ] Improve selector guessing algorithm.
- [ ] Add Chrome version of extension
- [ ] Add online registry for ScrapeConfigs
- [ ] **Add tests**
- [ ] Add mustache based custom output formats
